Doomsday Device.name: Doomsday Device
Doomsday Device.description:
Activate 10 minutes Interact

This unassuming, palm-sized box has a simple red button and is filled with some of the most devastating, complex weaponry to ever exist. All creatures who see it inherently sense the danger present from the box. When Activated by a living creature, choose a duration of up to 1 week after the Activation. Once the duration has elapsed, an explosion detonates in a 5-mile radius, dealing @Damage[12d6[fire]] to creatures and objects in the area. Each creature or object can attempt a @Check[type:reflex|dc:42|basic:true|name:Reflex|traits:fire]. Any creature or object reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage dies or is destroyed. A Doomsday Device can be safely disarmed during the period of its activation, with two consecutive successful checks against a @Check[type:thievery|traits:|dc:42]{Disable Device}, but a critical failure reduces the duration until it explodes by half or 10 minutes, whichever is greater.

Communicator's Headpiece.name: Communicator's Headpiece
Communicator's Headpiece.description:
Activate 1 Interact

This device comes in a paired link. Wearing one of the pairs and Activating it allows you to hear and speak with another creature at a range of up to 5 miles. You must speak loudly and clearly to be heard by a creature wearing the other headpiece, or your voice is perceived as muffled and unintelligible. Once one of the pairs is activated, both pairs remain active for 1 hour before running out of power.

Knife Healing Innovation.name: Knife Healing Innovation
Knife Healing Innovation.description: You must be wielding your healing innovation to use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-inventors.inventors-actions.OAJJz0ey8LU37Ghc]{Invigoration Link}

Hook Chain (Lesser).name: Hook Chain (Lesser)
Hook Chain (Lesser).description:
Activate 1 Interact (manipulate)

This handheld device has a grappling hook coming from the side. When you aim it, the grappling hook launches outwards. The hook can then be recalled at force, pulling you towards your target. When you Activate, you target a creature, object, or square within 30 feet, latching onto the target for 1 minute or until you Activate your hook chain the listed number of times. If the target is a creature, make a ranged attack roll using the hook as a simple weapon and if you’re successful you and the target cannot move more than 30 feet from each other. You can release the hook chain by Interacting to retract it. The target can Escape from your hook chain and it can be targeted with attacks (AC 10).

You can Activate your hook chain while attached to pull yourself up to the length of your hook chain towards the target, ignoring any difficult terrain from this movement. After you complete this movement, the hook detaches and you land in a square adjacent to the target. If you do not land on a space of solid ground after this movement, you fall after using your next action. This is forced movement, so your movement doesn’t provoke reactions.

The Escape DC is 17, its Hardness is 5, it has 20 Hit Points, and the number of Activate actions is 2.

Club Healing Innovation.name: Club Healing Innovation
Club Healing Innovation.description: You must be wielding your healing innovation to use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-inventors.inventors-actions.OAJJz0ey8LU37Ghc]{Invigoration Link}

Marble Mines (Moderate).name: Marble Mines (Moderate)
Marble Mines (Moderate).description:
Activate 1 Interact

These strange metal balls blink with a red light. When thrown to the floor, the marbles beep, and begin to roll towards an opponent. When Activated, Marble Mines move 15 feet away from you in a straight line on a horizontal surface until they reach the end of their movement or move into a creature’s space. The GM might reduce or increase this distance based on the angle of the surface or the terrain. At the end of this movement, the mines occupy the listed area and make it difficult for creatures to move. Creatures that begin their turn in the space of the mines must attempt a Reflex save or fall prone. The first time a creature falls prone in a square occupied by mines, the mines detonate and creatures take the listed fire damage on a basic Reflex save and the mines are then destroyed. After 1 minute has passed, the mines breakdown and are destroyed.

The mines deal @Damage[1d4[fire]] fire damage, occupy a @Template[type:square|distance:5], and a @Check[type:reflex|dc:20|basic:true|name:Reflex|traits:fire].

Magitek Innovation.name: Magitek Innovation
Magitek Innovation.description: Your magitek innovation is an object of your design that weighs 1 Bulk and must be worn, held, or wielded to be able to use your unstable actions and to Cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-inventors.inventors-spells.rLpTFGCUUdXtUbaL]{Technomancy Ray}.

Phantasm Plug (Major).name: Phantasm Plug (Major)
Phantasm Plug (Major).description:
Activated Interact (manipulate)

This box is made specifically to entrap incorporeal entities. When you Activate the plug, it projects an ectoplasmic vacuum above it, sucking in an incorporeal creature within a 15- emanation of the space it was activated in for the listed duration. Incorporeal creatures in the area must make a Fortitude save each turn they remain in the area. After the duration has passed, the plug remains able to store spirits that were captured during its activation for the listed duration. Once a creature reduces its slowed condition from a Phantasm Plug to 0 or critically succeeds the initial save, it becomes immune to the effect of Phantasm Plug for 1 day.

If a creature is trapped within the gadget and you have another Phantasm Plug available, you can extend the duration by transferring the creature to its new plug. The creature can attempt to Escape during this transfer. If the creature escapes or the trap duration expires, it is immediately expelled into a space adjacent to the gadget and the gadget is destroyed.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Success The target is slowed 1 for 1 round.Failure The target becomes slowed 1 or increases its slowed value by 1 if it was already slowed, and the creature is @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} as long as it is slowed by this effect. The creature must attempt a new Fortitude save at the end of each turn it remains in the area while the gadget is active. On a failed save, its slowed condition increases by 1 (or 2 on a critical failure). A successful save reduces the slowed condition by 1 or by 2 on a critical success. If a creature would be unable to act due to the slowed condition from the plug, the creature must immediately attempt a Fortitude save, and on a failure it is sucked into the phantasm plug where it becomes trapped. If a creature would be destroyed while within the emanation, it can instead choose to become trapped by the plug. This trapping effect has the incapacitation trait.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} or increases its slowed value by 2 if it was already slowed.

The Escape and @Check[type:fortitude|dc:30|basic:false] DCs are 39, the initial Activation duration is 1 minute, and the trapped duration is 1 day.

Mobile Spy (Greater).name: Mobile Spy (Greater)
Mobile Spy (Greater).description:
Activate 1 Interact (manipulate)

Like the famous instant spy, this mechanical construct resembles a rolled up pillbug until it is activated. You Activate the spy by spending 10 minutes giving it explicit instructions on where to travel and supplying a small gemstone of 1 gp. After it has been Activated, the spy becomes a @Compendium[pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary-3.cKZtOsBlN3Qu8Kyq]{Clockwork Spy} for the listed duration and immediately attempts to follow your instructions, moving up to the listed distance before using Record Audio. You can also give your spy specific instructions on when to use its Self Destruct reaction when you first Activate it. After it has finished recording, it attempts to travel back to the location it originally received instructions or to another location specified at the time you Activate it. If your spy is unable to reach the specified location, either because instructions were unclear, the area was inaccessible, or the distance was too great, it returns to you without using Record Audio, leaving the supplied gemstone intact. Your surveillance spy cannot perform actions other than for movement, to Record Audio, or to Self Destruct and it ignores any creatures that would attempt to stop it.

The spy remains active for 8 hours and the distance is 5 miles.

Construct Controller.name: Construct Controller
Construct Controller.description:
Activated Interact (manipulate)

This small, cuboid drive rewires the programming of constructs, bidding them to do as you command. You insert the drive into a weak point in a creature with the construct trait, overriding its mind. The creature must attempt @Check[type:will|dc:28|basic:false] with the same effects as a @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.aIHY2DArKFweIrpf]{Command} spell. Creatures that succeed at their save are immune to the effect of Construct Controller for 1 day.

Universal Translator.name: Universal Translator
Universal Translator.description:
Activated Interact (auditory, manipulate)

This metal disk clicks onto the underside of your tongue, allowing you to filter through languages as if they were your own. You gain the effect of @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.SwUiVavHKMWG7t5K]{Truespeech} and @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.vTQvfYu2llKQedmY]{Translate} for 1 hour.

Brain Jar (Greater).name: Brain Jar (Greater)
Brain Jar (Greater).description:
Activate 10 minutes with a suitable corpse (manipulate)

This strange jar contains weird fluids and cables. A brain jar can be used to hold the nervous system of a dead creature, preserving the organic material and allowing it to communicate through a voice modulator for 10 minutes when Activated. The brain in the jar can answer questions that it knows or memories that it possessed while alive, but it only has knowledge the creature would have had and it refuses to answer any questions the creature would have refused to answer. You can ask the brain 3 questions. This jar uses the nervous system's latent memories rather than the creature’s mind, so the nervous system must be mostly intact. The more damage the nervous system has taken, the more inaccurate or patchwork its answers are. The nervous system can attempt a Will save to resist answering the questions using the statistics of the original creature at its time of death, with the following effects. A nervous system inside of a brain jar remains preserved for 1 day after its Activation.

Success The target can provide false information or refuse to answer your questions.

Failure The target must answer truthfully, but its answers can be brief, cryptic, and repetitive. It can still mislead you or attempt to stall so that the spell's duration runs out before you can ask all your questions.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target's answers are more direct and less repetitive, though still cryptic. It takes a –2 status penalty to Deception checks to deceive or mislead you.

A greater brain jar functions as a brain jar, except the @Check[type:will|dc:38|basic:false], duration is extended to 1 day and the number of questions it can answer is unlimited, but after it is asked 3 questions, it can attempt a new save against this effect.

Power Gauntlet (Lesser).name: Power Gauntlet (Lesser)
Power Gauntlet (Lesser).description:
Activate 1 Interact

These thick, metal gloves have a slot in the back of the hand for retrieving the gauntlet back to its original location. The process of attaching a Power Gauntlet takes 1 minute.

When you Activate Power Gauntlet, clockwork gears project the gauntlet making a ranged Strike with your gauntlet at a target within 30 feet of you and dealing fire damage instead of its normal damage type. Your Strike does not apply your Strength to damage, but does apply any other effects that would apply to your melee Strikes with the gauntlet.

You can Sustain the Activation of your power gauntlet to make additional Strikes for the duration. You can make a number of ranged Strikes up to the listed maximum number of Strikes. Starting on the turn after you Activate the power gauntlet, each time you Sustain the activation on your turn, you gain the effects of the activation again: you make a ranged Strike with your gauntlet. The gadget is consumed after it reaches the listed maximum of Strikes per use or 1 minute has passed, whichever comes first, but the gauntlet continues to function as normal.

The gauntlet's maximum number of ranged Strikes is 2 and the
duration is 1 minute.

X-Ray Goggles.name: X-Ray Goggles
X-Ray Goggles.description:
Activated Interact (manipulate, visual)

These peculiar goggles glow a pale green and allow the wearer to see through creatures and objects. When Activated, you can use @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} to see through and into solid materials within 60 feet for 10 minutes. When you Seek, you decide which creatures or objects you wish to see through, gaining vision of the area and ignoring the chosen creatures or objects. This ability is blocked by 2 feet of wood, 1 foot of stone, 2 inches of common metal, or 1 inch of lead or any starmetal, and it limits the target to black-and-white vision while in use. You don't gain the benefit of any other special visual senses (such as low-light vision) while using x-ray vision, and you can't see beyond 60 feet with your goggles. You can use your goggles as part of a 10-minute activity, such as @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} or @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}, but you must declare what creatures or objects you are choosing to ignore as part of your search. Creatures you observe or ignore with your goggles display only bones, metal, stone, or other materials, as the goggles are not precise enough to target armor or clothing specifically.

Junkcraft Jetpack.name: Junkcraft Jetpack
Junkcraft Jetpack.description:
Activate 1 Interact (move)

This strange, cone-shaped backpack can spurt fire from behind, allowing you to take flight.

When you Activate Junkcraft Jetpack, spurts of fire from boosters on your back propel you, and you Fly up to 60 feet in any direction. During this movement, you must succeed at a @Check[type:acrobatics|traits:|dc:20] to turn up to 90 degrees, and you can't turn more than once or more than 90 degrees. During the activation and after the activation is complete, you can't Stride, Step, or otherwise move on the ground until the end of your next turn. You do not fall as long as your jetpack is active.

You can Sustain the activation of your Junkcraft Jetpack for up to 1 minute. Starting on the turn after you Activate the jetpack, the first time you Sustain the activation each turn, you gain the effects of the activation again: you Fly up to 60 feet in the same direction as your last movement with the jetpack, and the restrictions continue to apply until you reach the maximum duration. Once the effect ends, the jetpack is out of fuel and you fall if you are still airborne.

Quantum Duplicator.name: Quantum Duplicator
Quantum Duplicator.description:
Activate 10 minutes Interact

By twisting the dials and knobs of this platformed device, you create a temporary duplicate of yourself from another reality. When activated, this creates an NPC with your exact personality and goals that lasts for 24 hours. Because of their transplanar nature, they cannot overwork themselves—they have 1 Hit Point, automatically fail any saves they would make, and gain the @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition if they are ever in danger. You can perform downtime activities with your duplicate as if it were you, gaining the knowledge and benefits of its activities when you stand on the platform after the duration has expired. When you Activate the gadget, the GM rolls a secret @Check[type:flat|dc:2|showDC:all|traits:secret]. On a failure, the duplicate is evil, and will secretly work against you and the knowledge transferred from the platform may be corrupted.

Miniaturization Device.name: Miniaturization Device
Miniaturization Device.description:
Activated Strike

This device fires a ray that shrinks objects and creatures alike. Make a ranged attack roll, treating the miniaturization device as a simple weapon for the purposes of proficiency. On a hit, the target must attempt a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:29|basic:false]. On a critical hit, treat the save result as one degree worse. You can choose to target a willing creature, and if you do you automatically succeed at your attack roll and they gain the effect of the degree of success of their choice.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target reduces its reach by 5 feet to a minimum of 5 feet of reach for 1 minute.

Failure As success, except the target reduces its reach by 10 feet and becomes one size category smaller to a minimum size of Tiny.

Critical Failure As failure, except the target becomes two size categories smaller and the duration is 1 hour. This is an incapacitation effect.

Telescopic Monocle.name: Telescopic Monocle
Telescopic Monocle.description:
Activate 1 Interact (Manipulate)

This monocle can zoom in closely, allowing you to see far, far away. Once activated, you can view creatures, objects, and terrain features that are more than 30 feet away and up to 300 feet away as though they were only 30 feet away, removing any circumstance penalties to visual Perception checks that would result from a distance greater than 30 feet. After 10 minutes, the monocle lens cracks, and you can no longer focus.

If a creature would be unable to act due to the slowed condition from the plug, the creature must immediately attempt a Fortitude save, and on a failure it is sucked into the phantasm plug where it becomes trapped. If a creature would be destroyed while within the emanation, it can instead choose to become trapped by the plug. This trapping effect has the incapacitation trait.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} or increases its slowed value by 2 if it was already slowed.

The Escape and @Check[type:fortitude|dc:17|basic:false] DCs are 17, the initial Activation duration is 3 rounds, and the trapped duration is 10 minutes.

Power Gauntlet (Greater).name: Power Gauntlet (Greater)
Power Gauntlet (Greater).description:
Activate 1 Interact

These thick, metal gloves have a slot in the back of the hand for retrieving the gauntlet back to its original location. The process of attaching a Power Gauntlet takes 1 minute.

When you Activate Power Gauntlet, clockwork gears project the gauntlet making a ranged Strike with your gauntlet at a target within 30 feet of you and dealing fire damage instead of its normal damage type. Your Strike does not apply your Strength to damage, but does apply any other effects that would apply to your melee Strikes with the gauntlet.

You can Sustain the Activation of your power gauntlet to make additional Strikes for the duration. You can make a number of ranged Strikes up to the listed maximum number of Strikes. Starting on the turn after you Activate the power gauntlet, each time you Sustain the activation on your turn, you gain the effects of the activation again: you make a ranged Strike with your gauntlet. The gadget is consumed after it reaches the listed maximum of Strikes per use or 1 minute has passed, whichever comes first, but the gauntlet continues to function as normal.

The gauntlet's maximum number of ranged Strikes is 7 and the duration is 1 hour.

Spirit Box.name: Spirit Box
Spirit Box.description:
Activate 10 Minutes (auditory, manipulate)

This strange box has an array of meters reading your area's temperature, pressure and more. The box sends out strange frequencies and sounds for 1 minute, which can be manipulated by unseen visitors. Spirits within 80 feet can hear through the box, and speak in one word sentences through the box. While primarily aimed at attracting the attention of ghosts, it can also be manipulated by celestials, fiends, monitors, or similar creatures if they have the ability to communicate with telepathy or similar magic from another plane.

Phantasm Plug (Moderate).name: Phantasm Plug (Moderate)
Phantasm Plug (Moderate).description:
Activated Interact (manipulate)

This box is made specifically to entrap incorporeal entities. When you Activate the plug, it projects an ectoplasmic vacuum above it, sucking in an incorporeal creature within a 15- emanation of the space it was activated in for the listed duration. Incorporeal creatures in the area must make a Fortitude save each turn they remain in the area. After the duration has passed, the plug remains able to store spirits that were captured during its activation for the listed duration. Once a creature reduces its slowed condition from a Phantasm Plug to 0 or critically succeeds the initial save, it becomes immune to the effect of Phantasm Plug for 1 day.

If a creature is trapped within the gadget and you have another Phantasm Plug available, you can extend the duration by transferring the creature to its new plug. The creature can attempt to Escape during this transfer. If the creature escapes or the trap duration expires, it is immediately expelled into a space adjacent to the gadget and the gadget is destroyed.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Success The target is slowed 1 for 1 round.Failure The target becomes slowed 1 or increases its slowed value by 1 if it was already slowed, and the creature is @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} as long as it is slowed by this effect. The creature must attempt a new Fortitude save at the end of each turn it remains in the area while the gadget is active. On a failed save, its slowed condition increases by 1 (or 2 on a critical failure). A successful save reduces the slowed condition by 1 or by 2 on a critical success. If a creature would be unable to act due to the slowed condition from the plug, the creature must immediately attempt a Fortitude save, and on a failure it is sucked into the phantasm plug where it becomes trapped. If a creature would be destroyed while within the emanation, it can instead choose to become trapped by the plug. This trapping effect has the incapacitation trait.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} or increases its slowed value by 2 if it was already slowed.

The Escape and @Check[type:fortitude|dc:22|basic:false] DCs are 22, the initial Activation duration is 5 rounds, and the trapped duration is 1 hour. minutes.

Marble Mines (Greater).name: Marble Mines (Greater)
Marble Mines (Greater).description:
Activate 1 Interact

These strange metal balls blink with a red light. When thrown to the floor, the marbles beep, and begin to roll towards an opponent. When Activated, Marble Mines move 15 feet away from you in a straight line on a horizontal surface until they reach the end of their movement or move into a creature’s space. The GM might reduce or increase this distance based on the angle of the surface or the terrain. At the end of this movement, the mines occupy the listed area and make it difficult for creatures to move. Creatures that begin their turn in the space of the mines must attempt a Reflex save or fall prone. The first time a creature falls prone in a square occupied by mines, the mines detonate and creatures take the listed fire damage on a basic Reflex save and the mines are then destroyed. After 1 minute has passed, the mines breakdown and are destroyed.

The mines deal @Damage[3d4[fire]] fire damage, occupy a @Template[type:square|distance:10], and a @Check[type:reflex|dc:29|basic:true|name:Reflex|traits:fire].

Hook Chain (Major).name: Hook Chain (Major)
Hook Chain (Major).description:
Activate 1 Interact (manipulate)

This handheld device has a grappling hook coming from the side. When you aim it, the grappling hook launches outwards. The hook can then be recalled at force, pulling you towards your target. When you Activate, you target a creature, object, or square within 30 feet, latching onto the target for 1 minute or until you Activate your hook chain the listed number of times. If the target is a creature, make a ranged attack roll using the hook as a simple weapon and if you’re successful you and the target cannot move more than 30 feet from each other. You can release the hook chain by Interacting to retract it. The target can Escape from your hook chain and it can be targeted with attacks (AC 10).

You can Activate your hook chain while attached to pull yourself up to the length of your hook chain towards the target, ignoring any difficult terrain from this movement. After you complete this movement, the hook detaches and you land in a square adjacent to the target. If you do not land on a space of solid ground after this movement, you fall after using your next action. This is forced movement, so your movement doesn’t provoke reactions.

The Escape DC is 39, its Hardness is 15, it has 60 Hit Points, and the number of Activate actions is 8.
